day_debate.speaker: Jin

day_debate.speaker: Cong

day_debate.speaker: Hoang
day_debate.statement: Cong's immediate defensiveness and redirection towards Jin is highly concerning. Their lack of substantive response to Jin's observation suggests a deliberate attempt to deflect scrutiny. I propose we focus our attention on Cong.
